notes.title: Puke Hotfix
notes.content:
Dear players, the new hotfix is now available:

[list]
[*] The first "jumpscare" scene in the factory has been reworked and re-lit.
[*] The continuous camera shaking after "jumpscare" scenes has been fixed.
[*] Some spelling errors have been corrected.
[*] NPC running speed has been adjusted.
[*] The mismatch between animation and sound has been resolved.
[*] The interaction key has been changed from "T" to "E".
[*] Environmental elements blocking access in certain areas have been removed.
[*] The bug causing language changes in the main menu has been fixed.
[*] Subtitles have been added to the game intro.
[*] Night lighting in some areas has been adjusted.
[*] Two new types of "jumpscares" have been added to two different daytime scenes.
[*] A new type of "jumpscare" has been added to night scenes.
[/list]

notes.title: Puke Hotfix
notes.content:
As Skyfect™️, our team continues to work tirelessly on the early access game 'Puke.' We are excited to share with you the new features and bug fixes we've introduced in the 0.5.3 update.

[b]News:[/b]

[list]
[*] English language option added
[*] New sound effects (VFX) added
[*] Sound effects added to church doors
[*] NPCs now follow our character during the early days of the game
[/list]

[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b]

[list]
[*] Our character now screams and the screen goes dark when entering the fire
[*] The 'Nightfollower' duplication issue has been fixed
[*] Mission system notifications have been adjusted
[*] The issue of entering the lower part of the church before the required time has been fixed
[*] The bug preventing day transition on the night of Day 5 due to an incomplete mission has been resolved
[*] We also fixed the issue of continuous camera shaking
[/list]


We will continue to do our best for our valued players, and we will increase our updates regularly.
We wish you a great gaming experience!
Skyfect Team

notes.title: Puke 0.4.3 Update
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

As the Puke development team, we are very happy to present the 0.4.3 update to you. We will continue to bring many updates until our game completes its early access phase.

What we have added with the 0.4.3 update:

[list]
[*] The game tutorial section added
[*] The main menu fixed and changed
[*] We say goodbye to our cute character in T-pose; we fixed that too :)
[*] New horror elements added
[*] A "to be continued" section was added to ensure the continuation of the game
[/list]
Don't forget to follow us to access new updates and patch notes!
Have a good day dear players....

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that our game has officially launched today.

We will be providing frequent updates to the game until its early access phase is completed. We are pleased to inform you that the update on July [b]19th[/b] will fix many bugs and offer a better gameplay experience.

Please don't forget to follow Skyfect to stay updated on more developments coming soon!
